test_title: PYST 50: SSC GD Constable - English (Held on: 8th December 2021 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select ‘No substitution required’.

__General speaking,__ the great discoverers were people with great courage.
solution:
The solution is **Generally speaking**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in "General speaking,__ the great discoverers were people with great courage." is Generally speaking.
 
• Generally speaking__,__ the great discoverers were people with great courage.
 
• Here the word **General **is incorrect and the correct word is **Generally**.
 
• Therefore **option 4 **is the correct option.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• ***Generally speaking,*** is an *adverb.*
 
• **Adverb - **A word or a phrase that modifies or qualifies an adjective, or another adverb, or a group of words expressing a relation of place, time, etc.
